headline: Labor Day — OC + Virginia Beach packed · then football Saturday

big_money.title: Ocean City Labor Day crush
big_money.note: Fri Sep 4–Mon Sep 7. Biggest weekend of the OC year. Boardwalk Inlet–27th still live. Seacrets packed.
